MAGPlot 2.0's rule set

Source: R/magp_rules.R
magp_rules.Rd

The rule set that configures the engine for MAGPlot 2.0. Its rules rows say where and how registered rules apply, and its settings rows give MAGPlot's settings, which take the rule-set place in the settings precedence (see groundplotqc_options).

Usage

magp_rules()

Value

A named list of data.tables, in this order:

  • meta, one row: rule_set_name, version (raised by one in each pull request that changes a rules_*.csv), date (the day of the last change) and spec_version (the date of the specification files it was written for);

  • rules: rule_id, table_name, attribute_name ("*" for all), severity and class (blank to leave them to a less specific row, then to the registered value; for severity, the severity setting given as an option comes before the registered value, and given as an argument overrides every row) and enabled;

  • settings: setting, value and type.

Each carries the attributes source_file, the name of the file it was read from, source_lines, the file line each row starts on, and source_sha256, the SHA-256 of its rows; pre-flight's findings cite the lines while the rows are unchanged.

Examples

rules <- magp_rules()
rules$meta
#>    rule_set_name version       date spec_version
#>           <char>  <char>     <char>       <char>
#> 1:   MAGPlot 2.0       3 2026-10-19     20261005
rules$settings
#>                      setting
#>                       <char>
#>  1:                     lang
#>  2:              example_cap
#>  3:       column_level_min_n
#>  4:            raw_na_policy
#>  5:              rogue_codes
#>  6:            unknown_codes
#>  7:    coordinate_attributes
#>  8:      code_set_max_values

#> 12:       design_geometry_by
#> 13:  design_geometry_columns
